headline: OPEC+ agrees to extend voluntary oil output cuts of 2.2 million bpd.
US crude inventories fell by 1.4 million barrels last week, EIA reports.
Tensions in the Middle East escalate, raising supply disruption fears for Brent Crude.
China's manufacturing PMI drops to 48.5, signaling reduced crude oil demand.
US Strategic Petroleum Reserve releases 30 million barrels to combat rising gasoline prices.
